deployments_detail.use: CROP AI project (TÜBİTAK-backed) for color-defect detection in glass manufacturing at Eskişehir facility to reduce production waste and carbon emissions

CROP (Glass Color Optimization Project): machine-learning models the batch/blend components and furnace/production parameters affecting glass color and color stability, to eliminate color defects and reduce production waste and carbon emissions. Launched at the Eskişehir Glassware factory; consortium with Koç University, TÜBİTAK AI Institute and Analythinx, backed by TÜBİTAK 1711 AI 2023 Call. [Analythinx; Koç University; TÜBİTAK AI Institute]

Dataiku-based factory analytics: deployed models give plant operators real-time recommendations, enabling 24/7 production processes to be automatically managed; data collection, digital twins and factory-KPI analytics democratized from operators to R&D. [Dataiku (via Komtaş/Analythinx)]

Digital Twin Project: securely collects and analyzes process data from 60,000 points via industrial IoT; machine-learning algorithms model furnaces (color, heat, hearth, form, content), driving data-driven optimization and OEE dashboards to raise production efficiency and cut energy use. [none]

Soda ash Advanced Process Control (APC): AI/ML-driven autonomous operations management that keeps production processes optimized and self-regulating. Initial phase concluded in 2025. [global technology suppliers (unnamed)]

Self-optimizing glass furnace: digital twins of glass furnaces combined with advanced analytical models and automation, described as a pioneering application of physical AI and machine learning; analytical models reached simultaneous deployment across multiple plants and furnaces. [global technology partners (unnamed)]

UiPath 'Document Understanding' + RPA to classify 50,000+ hiring/HR documents prepared in 12 languages (structured, semi-structured, unstructured) in the OpenText system, replacing manual document management. Won UiPath's AI25 award. [UiPath; OpenText]
deployments_detail.value: 87.5% efficiency improvement in document management; 6x increase in daily classification capacity; 50,000+ documents in 12 languages

deployments_detail.use: ICRON Integrated Business Planning (IBP) for end-to-end supply chain: machine-learning demand forecasting, AI-powered production scheduling and line-load balancing across global plants, with native real-time bidirectional SAP S/4HANA integration. Operational, automating previously manual planning. [ICRON; SAP S/4HANA]

AI in recruitment and corporate HR document management: AI-supported candidate evaluation to minimize bias, plus AI/ML-guided digital storage/classification of candidate and employee documents. Implemented in recruitment processes in Türkiye, Russia and Bulgaria by end of 2024. [none]
AI-powered maintenance spare-parts optimization pilot: an AI pilot study optimized maintenance spare parts and defined the integration processes, part of predictive-maintenance efforts. [none]

Şişecam Academy AI-based translation: uses artificial intelligence to translate training/learning content into various languages with internal resources, accelerating training content production globally. [none]

R&TD Chatbot: generative-AI-supported knowledge-management assistant leveraging institutional knowledge for technical data access; a generative-AI MVP reached the deployment stage in 2025 for company-wide knowledge sharing. [none]

Generative-AI chatbot solutions for business units: implementing gen-AI chatbots to boost business-unit efficiency while addressing data-security risks; company also developing ready-to-use generative-AI applications for multi-content production. [none]
